title: Reinforcement Learning Can Be Recovered From Its Own Rollouts
abstract: arXiv:2611.33102v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Broadly speaking, reinforcement learning (RL) post-training converts compute into model capabilities by training on model-generated data. Typically, the rollouts are discarded after each update, and the knowledge acquired during RL resides in the model weights. In this work, we investigate how much of this knowledge is retained in the rollouts themselves. A natural first attempt is to replay the original RL algorithm on archived rather than freshly generated rollouts, but this leads to catastrophic collapse. We provide a simple explanation for this phenomenon, which in turn suggests a remedy: maximum likelihood on the archived rollouts. Surprisingly, starting from the same base model and replaying the rollouts in the order in which they were generated, without any distinction between correct and incorrect responses, is sufficient to recover the performance of online RL. translated_title: 强化学习可以从其自身的采样轨迹中恢复
translated_abstract: 广义而言，强化学习（RL）后训练通过在模型生成的数据上进行训练，将计算资源转化为模型能力。通常，采样轨迹在每次更新后都会被丢弃，RL过程中获得的知识仅存在于模型权重之中。在这项工作中，我们研究了这些知识有多少被保留在采样轨迹本身之中。一个自然的初步尝试是在存档的采样轨迹（而非新生成的轨迹）上重放原始的RL算法，但这会导致灾难性崩溃。我们为这一现象提供了一个简单的解释，并由此提出了一种补救方法：对存档的采样轨迹进行最大似然训练。令人惊讶的是，从同一个基础模型出发，按照采样轨迹生成的顺序进行重放，并且不区分正确与错误的响应，就足以恢复在线RL的性能。事实上，每个采样轨迹批次只需一次最大似然更新，就能接近（原文此处截断）
tldr: 该论文发现，仅通过对存档的RL采样轨迹按其生成顺序进行最大似然训练、且无需区分响应的对错，就能从同一基础模型完全恢复出在线强化学习的性能，表明RL所获得的知识实质上蕴含在采样数据本身之中。
en_tdlr: Maximum likelihood training on archived RL rollouts, replayed in their original generation order without distinguishing correct from incorrect responses, is sufficient to recover the full performance of online reinforcement learning from the same base model.
